messages:
Alex S: Customer (Acme Logistics, acct-9876) reports their monthly invoice auto-charge failed — 3 attempts in 45m all declined.
Priya B: Can you paste gateway tx id + last4 + decline message?
Alex S: tx_id: tx_20250325_99f, last4: 1111, gateway_msg: "decline: LIMIT_EXCEEDED; MCC_NOT_ALLOWED". They say card active and balance OK.
Jamie P: Acquirer response includes two hard declines: LIMIT_EXCEEDED (card-level monthly cap) and MCC_NOT_ALLOWED (company policy blocks MCC 4784).
Lina E: Can we get raw auth JSON (mask PAN) for triage?
Alex S: ```
{ "tx_id":"tx_20250325_99f", "auth_code":"AUTH203", "decline_code":"05", "reason":"LIMIT_EXCEEDED; MCC_NOT_ALLOWED", "merchant_mcc":"4784", "amount_cents":612000 }
```
Priya B: MCC 4784 = freight/transportation. Company default policy blocks transportation MCCs. Also this card has per-merchant monthly cap $5,000; invoice = $6,120.
Jamie P: Both constraints fired simultaneously. Acquirer returned hard declines — no re-try token provided.
Alex S: Customer insists this vendor is a regular supplier (warehouse freight). They want the charge to go through so subscription doesn't lapse.
Lina E: Short-term options: 1) customer pays invoice via ACH/wire, 2) we issue a virtual single-use card for this vendor with an increased per-merchant limit + explicit MCC allow. Ops can audit afterwards.
Priya B: We require a PO and authorized finance approval to process a one-time override. Ask customer to send PO# + finance contact + invoice id.
payments-bot: NOTE: Internal API for overrides: `POST /internal/v1/cards/overrides` payload: company_id, vendor_id, amount_cents, expires_at, reason — ops review required. Use audit tag `override:manual-charge`.
Jamie P: I'll open an acquirer escalation (ref tx_20250325_99f) to confirm no retrospective auth possible. If acquirer says no, only manual override or alternate payment works.
Alex S: Customer provided PO# PO-8891 and finance approver sara@acme.com. They prefer a virtual card if we can expedite.
Priya B: I'll prepare the override docs. Ops can issue a virtual card for `vendor:acme_freight` with MCC allow 4784, limit $10,000, TTL 7 days. Will need finance signoff recorded.
Lina E: Filing internal ticket INF-5987 to add an alert when MCC_NOT_ALLOWED and LIMIT_EXCEEDED co-occur so support can suggest virtual card automatically.
Ops: We can create the virtual card if billing attaches PO + signed confirmation. Expected issuance ETA 1 business hour once docs are in.
Alex S: Thanks — sharing the steps with customer now and requesting signed PO. Will update thread once they confirm which path (virtual card vs manual payment). :thumbsup:
Priya B: Follow-up: override approved pending signed PO. I'll update invoice status and close after settlement. :white_check_mark:
